tours.name: Payroll Month-End Checklist
tours.description: Learn the checks to complete at the end of each payroll month: work entries, batches and their status, payslips waiting to be paid, and the payroll report.

description_i18n.en_US: Learn the checks to complete at the end of each payroll month: work entries, batches and their status, payslips waiting to be paid, and the payroll report.

steps.title: Open Payroll
steps.description: Use this walkthrough every month to make sure nothing is missing before the pay period is closed.

description_i18n.en_US: Use this walkthrough every month to make sure nothing is missing before the pay period is closed.

steps.title: Work Entries menu
steps.description: Step 1 is to check the attendance and leave records that the payslips are based on.

description_i18n.en_US: Step 1 is to check the attendance and leave records that the payslips are based on.

steps.title: Work Entries
steps.description: Work entries record the days and hours each employee worked or was absent. Conflicts must be resolved here, otherwise the payslips will be wrong.

description_i18n.en_US: Work entries record the days and hours each employee worked or was absent. Conflicts must be resolved here, otherwise the payslips will be wrong.

steps.title: Review the entries
steps.content: Check there are no conflicts, then click the search bar to continue.

content_i18n.en_US: Check there are no conflicts, then click the search bar to continue.

steps.description: Entries in conflict are shown in red or flagged. Fix them before generating or confirming the payslips.

description_i18n.en_US: Entries in conflict are shown in red or flagged. Fix them before generating or confirming the payslips.

steps.title: Payslips menu
steps.description: Step 2 is to check that every batch of the month is generated and confirmed.

description_i18n.en_US: Step 2 is to check that every batch of the month is generated and confirmed.

steps.title: Batches
steps.description: This list shows each batch with its period, status and number of payslips.

description_i18n.en_US: This list shows each batch with its period, status and number of payslips.

steps.title: Batch status
steps.content: Look at the Status column, then click it to continue.

content_i18n.en_US: Look at the Status column, then click it to continue.

steps.description: A batch moves from New to Confirmed, then Done and finally Paid. At month end, every batch of the period should be Done or Paid.

description_i18n.en_US: A batch moves from New to Confirmed, then Done and finally Paid. At month end, every batch of the period should be Done or Paid.

steps.title: Payslips menu again
steps.description: Step 3 is to check the salaries that are still waiting to be paid.

description_i18n.en_US: Step 3 is to check the salaries that are still waiting to be paid.

steps.title: To Pay
steps.description: This list shows the payslips that are confirmed but not yet paid. It should be empty once the salaries have been transferred.

description_i18n.en_US: This list shows the payslips that are confirmed but not yet paid. It should be empty once the salaries have been transferred.

steps.title: Review the list
steps.content: Check the list, then click the search bar to continue.

content_i18n.en_US: Check the list, then click the search bar to continue.

steps.description: Any payslip still listed needs to be paid or investigated before the month is closed.

description_i18n.en_US: Any payslip still listed needs to be paid or investigated before the month is closed.

steps.title: Reporting menu
steps.description: Step 4 is to review the figures of the month.

description_i18n.en_US: Step 4 is to review the figures of the month.

steps.title: Payroll report
steps.description: The payroll report summarises gross pay, deductions and net pay by month, department or employee, so you can compare it with the previous month.

description_i18n.en_US: The payroll report summarises gross pay, deductions and net pay by month, department or employee, so you can compare it with the previous month.

steps.title: Check the figures
steps.content: Review the totals, then click the search bar to finish.

content_i18n.en_US: Review the totals, then click the search bar to finish.

steps.description: If the totals look unusual compared with last month, open the payslips behind them before closing the month.

description_i18n.en_US: If the totals look unusual compared with last month, open the payslips behind them before closing the month.
